sources.title: EINAUX — ACENTAUR & AUTUMI: AI plug-ins for your DAW
sources.snippet: ACENTAUR, a generative AI audio instrument, and AUTUMI, audio to MIDI: native AU/VST3 plug-ins for Logic Pro, Ableton Live and LUNA. Local on your Mac.

sources.title: Transparency — what ACENTAUR is built on | EINAUX
sources.snippet: ACENTAUR builds on openly released music models from Stability AI and ACE-Step, on Apple MLX. What EINAUX adds, and what never leaves your Mac.

sources.title: einaux/acentaur-mlx-models · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Get ACENTAUR and product information at https://www.einaux.com. The packages use Acentaur's versioned internal checkpoint contract. Each package contains a manifest.json that pins its upstream model revision and source file metadata. Download and installation are managed by ACENTAUR Setup; cloning the complete repository is unnecessary.
